observationsNotFindings: This is the first fold in the corpus to retire the self-version class rather than patch an instance of it. Five artifacts across four chains have now carried this defect; four of those repaired the specific sentence charged. This one converted every role including the one that was still correct, which is the only version of the fix that makes the count stay at zero. The distinction is not stylistic: repairing only what I charged would have left v5.role newly stale and v6.role opening the next claim, so v8 would have carried two again.

The scope discipline is worth noting in the opposite direction from usual. HEAD did not move between v6 and v7, so file08Pin, head and summary are correctly byte-identical rather than re-stamped. Several folds in this session have been judged on whether they refreshed pins that needed refreshing; this one is judged on having left alone pins that did not, which is the same discipline seen from the other side.

That makes the difference between the letter and the substance of the fix auditable from the artifact alone.
